content: Wayland global hotkeys: no XGrabKey equivalent on Wayland. xdg-desktop-portal GlobalShortcuts (merged in xdg-desktop-portal 1.16.0) is the sanctioned API: supported by KDE Plasma (native) and GNOME (added later); wlroots/Sway do not implement it; Hyprland registers but requires assigning the binding in compositor config. Portal registration is a REQUEST: desktop controls approval, may change/ignore the combination; app must handle unassigned/denied. Requires matching .desktop file + app id. OpenWhispr #547: global hotkey fails on GNOME Wayland when portal unsupported — needs fallback. Alternative that dicta already uses: external evdev reader (/dev/input/event*) reading all keyboard devices directly — works everywhere with input-group permission but reads ALL keys system-wide (security tradeoff, dicta CONCERNS documents this). KDE-only alternative: KWin DBus scripting/custom shortcuts. dicta-settings already does 'always on top' via KWin — same KDE-only coupling pattern to avoid extending.
